title: ScholarChain query plan step arguments (planner rules scholarchain.rag.query-planner.v1)
description: The closed vocabulary of the `arguments` map of every core QueryStep (scholarchain.query-plan.v1) that the deterministic planner emits. Keys are fixed tokens; every value is untrusted user data or a planner tag, never query text, Cypher, a key, a table, an index or an AWS operation. Pinned to QueryPlanner.Args and QueryPlanner.AllowedOperations by QueryPlannerSuite.

name.description: resolve-researcher only: the researcher name as written in the question (data; hashed for the entity-link lookup).

researchers.description: Ordinals of the resolve-researcher steps whose resolved IDs this step uses, comma separated.

window.source.description: Whether the plan window was written in the question or is the configured runtime.defaultWindow.

filter.institution.description: Institution text from the question (data); on resolve-researcher steps it may narrow candidates to one whose stored affiliation name contains it.

ranking.rule.description: The documented ranking measure of a ranked intent (no universal formula).
